t: The Pump Card makes the Builder collect fluids from the selected area. The pumped fluid must be stored in a tank connected to the Builder.
泵卡使建筑机从所选区域内抽取流体。被抽取的流体必须储存于连接至建筑机的储罐中。
The normal Pump Card replaces removed fluid with the configured filler. The clearing variant leaves empty space instead.
普通泵卡会在移除流体后以设定填充物替代；清除变体则直接留出空气空间。
